The s3presign Runner (`server/runner/s3presign`) refreshes external attachment links every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup via `server/server.go:129`, where `Server.Start` calls `startBackgroundRunners`.

The runner also performs an immediate `RunOnce` at `server/server.go:163` before its continuous 12-hour cycle. The exact wiring site is still being weighed between `server/server.go:129` and `server/server.go:169`.

The exact answer is `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours — `server/server.go:129`. The runner is constructed at `server/server.go:162`.

h01.
s3presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`) — every 12 hours — `server/server.go:129`

`CheckAndPresign` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` re-presigns S3 attachment URLs before they expire. `runnerInterval` is `12 * time.Hour`. `Server.Start` wires it in via `s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)`, which constructs the runner, runs it once, then starts `Run` in a background goroutine.
